extraction_notes: Pacific Life multi-product "Workforce Benefits Proposal" PDFs contain many products (Dental, Vision, Basic Life/AD&D, Voluntary Life/AD&D, STD, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Accident), each with its own clearly labeled section headed "Group [Product Name] Insurance - [Tier Name]" (e.g. "Group Critical Illness Insurance - Standard"). For Critical Illness specifically: there is ONE age-banded rate table (titled "Uni-Tobacco Rates Attained Age per $1,000") with 12 age bands (18-25, 26-30, 31-35, 36-40, 41-45, 46-50, 51-55, 56-60, 61-65, 66-69, 70-74, 75-99) and 4 columns: Employee Coverage, Employee+Spouse Coverage, Employee+Child(ren) Coverage, Employee+Family Coverage. Note Employee and Employee+Child(ren) columns are identical values, and Employee+Spouse and Employee+Family columns are identical values (because spouse/child riders are rated as additive percentage of face, not reflected in this particular rate table - the per-$1,000 rate for the dependent-inclusive tiers equals employee rate plus a spouse loading, with children added at no extra per-unit cost in this table). Rates are monthly per $1,000 of coverage, uni-tobacco (no distinct smoker/non-smoker rates). Following the rate table on subsequent pages is a Plan Details table (Face Amount $30,000 flat benefit - not variable by employee choice in this proposal, Guarantee Issue $30,000, Employee 100%/Spouse 50%/Child 25% of face amount, voluntary contribution, child max age 26, coverage termination age 80, portability to age 70, pre-ex 3/12, age reduction to 50% at 70, no benefit waiting period, no lifetime max), then two benefit-schedule tables: "Benefits With Recurrence Provision" (18 conditions incl. Invasive Cancer, Heart Attack, Stroke, etc., values as % of benefit) and "Benefit Without Recurrence Provision" (11 adult conditions + 8 "Childhood Benefits" conditions, also % of benefit) - these are benefit percentage schedules, not separate coverage classes/rate grids, so not part of the age-banded extraction. Only 4 coverage classes exist for CI (Employee, Employee+Spouse, Employee+Child(ren), Employee+Family) - no separate standalone "Spouse" or "Child" class with their own independent rate table. Other products in the doc (Dental, Vision, Basic Life, Voluntary Life/AD&D, STD, Hospital Indemnity, Accident) should be ignored per task instructions when only Critical Illness is requested - each has its own distinct rate structure (flat composite tiers for Dental/Vision/Hospital Indemnity/Accident, age-banded for Voluntary Life and STD, flat for Basic Life). Document is ~45 pages; CI section spans pages 28-32 (header page, rate table page, plan details page, recurrence benefits page, non-recurrence+childhood benefits page, general info/exclusions page).
